note: SCHEMA REFERENCE, not corpus truth — the underscore prefix keeps it out of the loader. Real files are named <work>.json where <work> is a corpus.works id. Authoring rules live in docs/golden-queries.md: recall probes paraphrase the chunk's distinctive vocabulary (copied words make FTS hits self-fulfilling) and assert only tradition/work survival; relevance queries assert nothing and are graded post-hoc from the manifest. provenanceChunkIds record the chunks a query was drafted from — audit trail only, never asserted. frozenEval is the work-level train/eval partition: true = frozen eval subset, false = eligible for the fine-tune query distribution; the choice is one-way.
